Priority: P0 broken, P1 money, P2 growth. Every task has a `demand` field (keyword + monthly volume, GSC impressions/clicks, or calls at stake); P0 customer-visible breakage may use 'customer-visible' instead. No demand = not worked (DIGITAL-OS §0).
